concerns.text: SC-007 requires measuring the DIFFERENCE in FPR between LLM and human groups ('to detect tool bias'), but T006 only computes per-group precision/recall/FPR into audit_metrics.csv. No task performs or reports the between-group FPR comparison, so SC-007 has no covering task despite the coverage table claiming 'SC-006/SC-007 ... T006'.

The plan's Constitution Check states 'CWE taxonomy URLs are listed in research.md' (Principle VII), but T011's description of research.md does not include listing CWE taxonomy URLs or the per-CWE-class density breakdown reporting. Add this to T011 (or another task) so the plan element is covered.
